description: RasterizingBuildingFootprints is published by mehdiheris. It describes code that rasterises Microsoft building footprints into per-cell building counts and footprint-area statistics for large-area modelling. Coverage is national within US. Outputs are 30 m raster layers covering the 48 conterminous states. The data period and sampling interval are not fully established. Access is through the public repository and its documentation. Repository code is primarily Python. Software was not installed or executed. Licence: MIT.
